session.question: In the context of plastic waste management, what does "PS" refer to, and how is it described alongside the other plastic categories in the review of plastic products?
session.answer:
In this context, “PS” refers to polystyrene, also commonly described as styrofoam. It is presented as one of the standard plastic categories included in the review’s lifecycle discussion of plastic products and waste management. The paper lists PS alongside other common polymer categories such as PVC-U, PP, HDPE, and PETE, as part of an overview of plastic waste management and environmental impacts. (niyitanga2021plasticwasteand chunk 1)

The second review excerpt also indicates that “PS” is typically understood as polystyrene in the broader context of plastic waste management, although it does not explicitly define the abbreviation in the provided abstract. It is mentioned in the setting of plastic product categories relevant to electrocatalysis-driven upcycling. (wang2024electrocatalysis‐drivensustainableplastic chunk 1)
